THE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS CINEMATOGRAPH REGULATION, 1954
(EAST BENGAL REGULATION NO. I OF 1955)
[ 2th February, 1955   ]
A Regulation to apply the Cinematograph Act, 1918, to the Chittagong Hill-tracts.
Whereas it is expedient to apply the Cinematograph Act, 1918, to the Chittagong Hill-tracts;
And Whereas by sub-section (2) of section 92 of the Government of India Act, 1935, the  [REF_1][Government] is empowered to make regulations for the good Government of any area in which is for the time being an excluded or a partially excluded area;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the said powers and all other powers enabling him in that behalf, the [REF_2][Government] is pleased to make the following Regulation:-
Short title
1. This Regulation may be called the Chittagong Hill- tracts Cinematograph Regulation, 1954.
Application of Act II of 1918 to the Chittagong Hill-tracts
2. The Cinematograph Act, 1918, together with Rules made thereunder, shall, subject to the modification shown below, apply to the Chittagong Hill-tracts:-
Modification.
Sub-section (3) of section 1 shall be omitted.
1
The word "Government" was replaced for the words "Governor" by Article 9 of the Bangladesh (Adaptation of Existing Laws) Order, 1972 (President's Order No. 48 of 1972). 2
The word "Government" was replaced, for the words "Governor of East Bengal" by Article 9 of the Bangladesh (Adaptation of Existing Laws) Order, 1972 (President's Order No. 48 of 1972).
